content: If you want to go fast, go alone. If you want to go far, go together.
author: African Proverbs
explanation: Solitary speed is an illusion of ego: you may sprint across a short distance, but you will arrive exhausted, vulnerable, and without shelter. True enduring human accomplishment—surviving droughts, raising generations, building just societies—requires the shared rhythm of a bonded community.
practicalInsight: Instead of trying to solo-tackle a massive project today, invite trusted partners into the process and walk together.
reflectionPrompt: Where has your impatient impulse to 'go fast alone' caused you to burn out before reaching the horizon?
